message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"orchestrator","description":"Draft a concise set of clarifying questions to send to the user that elicit: the object to 'make better' (product, document, code, process, etc.), current pain points, measurable success metrics, constraints (time, budget, platform, access), existing files or links to review, priority areas, and a preferred timeline; include a recommended next-step sequence for the team to follow after the user replies.","dependencies":[],"produces":"clarifying_questions.md","consumes":[],"rationale":"Need clear, scoped requirements before any specialist work","needs_tools":[]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Using clarifying_questions.md (and the user's answers once provided), perform web and market research for the specified domain: collect benchmarks, competitor examples, best practices, relevant case studies, and feasible improvement options; estimate typical impacts and required effort for candidate approaches. Produce a concise research_findings.md with sources/links and prioritized opportunities.","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"research_findings.md","consumes":["clarifying_questions.md"],"rationale":"Gather domain knowledge and external evidence to guide improvements","needs_tools":["web_search","read_file"]},{"id":"s3","agent_id":"data_analyst","description":"From research_findings.md and any user-provided data access, define measurable success metrics, locate or extract baseline data, run quick queries or produce a baseline report, and document data sources, measurement methods, and current metric values in baseline_metrics.md. If access is not available, list exact data access steps needed and sample expected baselines.","dependencies":["s2"],"produces":"baseline_metrics.md","consumes":["research_findings.md"],"rationale":"Establish measurable baselines to quantify 'better' and enable evaluation","needs_tools":["read_file","terminal"]},{"id":"s4","agent_id":"creative","description":"Read research_findings.md and baseline_metrics.md; create 2–3 concrete, prioritized improvement proposals (design/content/workflow/feature) with expected effects on the defined metrics, implementation steps, rough effort (low/med/high), and acceptance/QA criteria. Write improvement_proposals.md suitable for handing to engineering and stakeholders.","dependencies":["s2","s3"],"produces":"improvement_proposals.md","consumes":["research_findings.md","baseline_metrics.md"],"rationale":"Translate research and metrics into concrete, actionable proposals","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]},{"id":"s5","agent_id":"coder","description":"Using improvement_proposals.md and baseline_metrics.md, produce an implementation_plan_and_prototype.md containing a concrete engineering plan, prioritized tasks, required changes, test plan, rollout and rollback steps, and either a small prototype or reproducible implementation steps and tests demonstrating the change. Verify code/artifacts where possible and include instructions to reproduce and measure impact.","dependencies":["s4","s3"],"produces":"implementation_plan_and_prototype.md","consumes":["improvement_proposals.md","baseline_metrics.md"],"rationale":"Implement and verify concrete changes so improvement can be realized and measured","needs_tools":["terminal","code_analysis","read_file","write_file"]}]}
